description.value:
Features

Switch Mode

Bonus Action.

As a Bonus Action, you can transform the weapon between Sword & Shield Mode and Axe Mode.

Elemental Attunement

Once per Short rest or Long rest, you can change the element attuned to this weapon.

Mastery (Sap) (Sword & Shield)

If you hit a creature, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

Mastery (Cleave) (Axe)

If you hit a creature, you can make an extra attack against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach.

Phial Charges

The weapon can hold up to 5 Phial Charges. Any unspent charges safely dissipate if you haven't made an attack with this weapon for 1 minute. The gauge starts at 0 after a Long Rest. When you hit a creature with an attack in Sword & Shield Mode, you generate 1 Phial Charge.

Guard Point (Elemental Guard)

Reaction.

You learn to perfectly time your blocks. As a Reaction when you are hit by a melee attack while in Sword & Shield Mode, you can expend 1 Phial Charge to add +2 to your AC against that attack. If this causes the attack to miss, your shield erupts, dealing [[/r 1d4]] damage of your Elemental Attunement type to the attacker.
